problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 20 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected benefit to the community. The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.139, disruption index is 0.101, allocation bounds [0.026, 0.773]
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.161, disruption index is 0.029, allocation bounds [0.026, 0.501]
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.166, disruption index is 0.062, allocation bounds [0.068, 0.545]
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.129, disruption index is 0.232, allocation bounds [0.086, 0.691]
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.042, disruption index is 0.090, allocation bounds [0.035, 0.582]
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.122, disruption index is 0.262, allocation bounds [0.072, 0.884]
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.078, disruption index is 0.047, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.673]
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.068, disruption index is 0.193, allocation bounds [0.035, 0.396]
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.052, disruption index is 0.053, allocation bounds [0.008, 0.327]
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.103, disruption index is 0.189, allocation bounds [0.044, 0.858]
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.099, disruption index is 0.024, allocation bounds [0.051, 0.847]
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.104, disruption index is 0.043, allocation bounds [0.024, 0.315]
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.194, disruption index is 0.021, allocation bounds [0.033, 0.665]
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.106, disruption index is 0.208, allocation bounds [0.037, 0.785]
* Project O: projected benefit is 0.172, disruption index is 0.260, allocation bounds [0.082, 0.606]
* Project P: projected benefit is 0.059, disruption index is 0.178, allocation bounds [0.042, 0.769]
* Project Q: projected benefit is 0.031, disruption index is 0.022, allocation bounds [0.064, 0.605]
* Project R: projected benefit is 0.189, disruption index is 0.218, allocation bounds [0.088, 0.649]
* Project S: projected benefit is 0.070, disruption index is 0.028, allocation bounds [0.014, 0.506]
* Project T: projected benefit is 0.130, disruption index is 0.217, allocation bounds [0.033, 0.429]
Each project must receive a budget share that falls within its specified minimum and maximum allocation bounds, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget. To ensure equitable regional development, the planner requires that the group of high-impact projects, represented by the subset H = {D, F, G, H, J, K, M, N, S}, collectively receive at least 0.432 of the total budget. Furthermore, the overall community disruption, measured by a composite disruption index, must not exceed 0.216, and the total projected benefit must be no less than 0.084. Please determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
